'''Jai'galaar''', also known simply as '''Jag''' and designated '''CT-55/11-9009''', was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] who took the [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] name Jai'galaar, Jag originally served as a [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], but was demoted to [[Captain/Legends|captain]] after the [[Retreat at Katraasii]]. However, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] drafted the captain as a test [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the new [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]]. During the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|battle]] over [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], Jag served as a wingman to Koon and [[Death/Legends|executed]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Biography==
[[File:JagOrder66.png|thumb|left|250px|Jag's [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] during the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].]]
CT-55/11-9009, who adopted the name Jai'galaar or simply Jag, was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].

At the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], then-[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] Jag commanded the [[127th Gunship Wing]].
A member of the famed [[CT-5]] batch of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], as well as an able and somewhat aggressive [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], although his destiny was to lead, not fly.

However, Jag was later disgraced and demoted after the tragic [[Retreat at Katraasii]]. Luckily for Jag, he was picked up by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who drafted Captain Jag as a test pilot for the new [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]].

When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Captain Jag, in his ARC-170 fighter, along with his squadron of ARC-170 starfighters shot down General Koon's [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class starfighter]] over [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|battle]] there, despite his feelings for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Plokoonjsf.png|thumb|right|180px|Jag's ARC-170 cockpit display screens.]]
Jag chose to utilize an [[Unidentified script (Star Wars '76)|unidentified script]] to display information on the cockpit display screen of his [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]]. Information was displayed in this script moments before shooting down [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor]].
